original_record.name: UDS-03 Neclien
original_record.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one individual game-ready base-pose sprite for a high-detail 2D side-on fighting game, PNG with actual transparent alpha background. Input image is an in-game visual reference ONLY, not the background or camera to copy. Faithfully translate the specific canonical character into clean detailed hand-painted 2D game art with precise contour, believable proportions and crisp readable shading. Subject: UDS-03 NECLIEN from Sega Zombie Revenge, the burning lanky humanoid monster in the screenshot. Preserve extremely thin emaciated charred almost black body with dark reddish sinews, narrow skull-like head, elongated forearms and gaunt legs, heavy dark metal shackles around both wrists. Several compact yellow-orange flames attached to shoulders, chest, arms and shins as seen in game, without a large aura. Full figure hunched in a threatening grounded idle pose facing right in three-quarter side view. No weapons stuck in body, no clothing, no oversized generic muscular fire elemental, no extra horns or wings. The charred body is intact and non-graphic. Composition: exactly ONE character, all canonical body parts visible, no clipping, centered with 10% transparent margin, eye-level orthographic three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. White-neutral studio light keeps the canonical palette; no scene lighting tint. Transparent everywhere except the character; NO ground plane, pedestal, cast shadow, checkerboard drawn into the image, scenery, UI, bars, text, labels, frame, watermark, other characters or weapon panels. This is a single idle sprite, NOT a sheet or turnaround. Preserve the referenced identity and costume; no redesign.
original_record.limitations: 2D adaptation based on an original in-game screenshot; exact 1:1 fidelity not certified.
